Road conditions

  • http://www.chart.state.md.us/ChartSystem/overview.asp (Maps for road conditions/route restrictions)

When Permit Is Needed

  • Over 8' wide
  • Over 13'6" high
  • Trailer over 48' long
  • Over 80,000 lbs.

Special Information Needed

  • Weight of trailer, truck, load
  • Make, model & serial # of load

Times Of Movement

  • 1/2 hour before sunrise to 1/2 hour after sunset; Sat until noon; no Sunday travel
  • Curfews: If load exceeds 45 tons GVW, 100’ in length, or 12’ in width travel on I-495/I-95/I-695 from 9am-3:30pm; if 14’ or more--9am-3:30pm on any highway
  • Prohibited holidays: New Year’s Day, Good Friday, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day , Christmas Day

When Pilot/Escort Vehicle is Required

http:.//www.dsd.state.md.us/comar/11/11.04.04.01.htm

http:.//www.dsd.state.md.us/comar/11/11.04.04.02.htm

http:.//www.dsd.state.md.us/comar/11/11.04.04.03.htm

http:.//www.dsd.state.md.us/comar/11/11.04.04.04.htm

On All Highways:

  • Over 13' -14’ wide (except mfg. homes)-1 escort
  • 14’ wide or more (including mfg. Home)-2 escorts
  • Over 85'-140’ long- 1escort
  • Over 140’ long-2 escorts
  • 14'6" high or more-1 w/high pole
  • Over 60 tons GVW- 1 escort
  • If road is too narrow to pass safely or if traffic will have to be diverted/stopped or weather/road conditions justify-2 (front & rear)

Police Escorts Needed When:

  • 16' wide or more
  • Over 60 tons GVW
  • Or if traffic will have to be diverted or stopped or if it will affect 2 or more lanes of traffic on a highway having only 1 lane in each direction

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle

  • General: No stipulations
  • Signs: “OVERSIZE LOAD”/”WIDE LOAD” sign w/ black letters (8” high) on yellow background (5’ x 12”)
  • Lights: 1 yellow oscillating or rotating roof light at least 3” in diameter; visible to front & rear; flashing warning lamps shall be used when vehicle is traveling 20 MPH or less than posted speed
  • Flags: Not stipulated
  • Additional equipment: 2-way radio

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle Operator

  • No stipulations
